summary: IsoEnergy Ltd., a TSX/NYSE-listed uranium developer incorporated in Canada, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Management's Discussion and Analysis and unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, dated November 4, 2026, signed by CFO Graham du Preez. The exhibits are incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form F-10 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed; this is ordinary periodic financial reporting, not a special situation.
